description: Creates an obsidian://new URI and formatted Markdown text. Use when the user wants to export notes, research, or documents into their local Obsidian vault. Supports note title, body content, optional vault name, tags, and YAML frontmatter. Opens Obsidian directly and writes the note to the local vault without cloud sync or server storage.

frontmatter.description: Optional custom key-value metadata to include in YAML frontmatter.

tags.description: Optional list of tags for YAML frontmatter.

title.description: Note title (used as note name in Obsidian).

vault.description: Optional name of the target Obsidian vault. If omitted, opens active vault.

name: create_obsidian_note

character_count.description: Length of the markdown content in characters.

filename.description: Suggested file name for saving as a .md file.

markdown_content.description: Full note text including structured YAML frontmatter.

obsidian_url.description: obsidian://new deep link to create note in Obsidian.

url_length.description: Total length of the obsidian:// URI.

warning.description: Warning if URI exceeds safe OS limits.

title: Create Obsidian note
